systems: Terraform (documented behaviour, not measured here): terraform plan refreshes state in memory, plans from the refreshed state and does not persist it, so drift the apply would correct appears in the plan
Ansible (documented behaviour, not measured here): --check runs each module in check mode against the live host and reports changed for a drifted item the real run would fix
Puppet (documented behaviour, not measured here): puppet agent --noop evaluates the catalog against the live system and reports would-have-changed events for drifted resources, without changing them
crux.verdict: No crux row is owed: the three systems preview from observed state rather than from a recorded one, which is what this diff makes forjar do while keeping the dry run write-free.
